weaknesses.title: COPYALL flattens to basenames — no relative-tree preserve
weaknesses.detail: src/a/x and src/b/x both become dest/x. Nested release trees collapse; deep.plate under nested/ not even scanned without recursion. No COPYALL --parents / relpath mode.

weaknesses.title: COPYALL silent basename collision last-wins
weaknesses.detail: Two sources same basename both COPYALL_N success; dest content is last writer. No COLLISION count or fail-on-exists mode.

weaknesses.title: COPYALL dirs fail soft; cannot stage directory trees
weaknesses.detail: Directory entries → COPYALL_FAIL. Need recursive walk glue or tar. Partial success OK=0 when mixed.
weaknesses.repro: COPYALL bag_with_dir → fail>=1 files still copied

weaknesses.title: MKDIRALL over existing file fails soft (cannot clobber)
weaknesses.detail: Useful safety but agents must pre-check ISFILE. No force mode.

weaknesses.title: DEST not language-global — agents need plate/ENV durability
weaknesses.detail: Multi-tick dest requires DEST.txt or CUBALC_RS_DEST; pure LET DEST dies each run. No process-persistent agent state beyond plates/env.
weaknesses.repro: dest action then new process without plate → default stage

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON bag newline collapse
weaknesses.detail: STAGED paths collapse in JSON line.

weaknesses.title: WRITE omits final trailing newline
weaknesses.detail: DEST.txt/STAGED last line without $ on cat -A.

weaknesses.title: No COPYALL dry-run / conflict preview
weaknesses.detail: Agents cannot list would-be basenames+collisions before write without reimplementing BASENAMEALL+FREQ.

workarounds: KEEPFILES before COPYALL to drop dir FAIL noise
BASENAMEALL+FREQ before stage to detect collisions
Persist DEST in DEST.txt plate across ticks
MKDIRALL tree paths for multi-dir stage layouts
CLEAR_ERR after partial COPYALL if copy_n>0 is success
